summary: Corbus Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose updated clinical data from its Phase 1/2 study of CRB-701 (SYS6002), a Nectin-4 targeted ADC, in oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma and cervical cancer. The data will be presented at the ASCO 2026 Annual Meeting. The filing is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results and does not involve a merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activism, or any other special situation. No deal terms, vote, or board recommendation are included. This is a standard current report for clinical updates.
